name: Phi Phi Islands
description: The speedboat trip, tropical scenery and the tide pulling the sea away while we were swimming made this a defining memory of our first Thailand visit.

name: Sintra
description: Absolutely phenomenal and too rich for a rushed day trip. Regaleira, Pena and Monserrate made me wish we had stayed at least one night.

name: Venice Canals
description: Every street feels original. Even after several visits, I still want to walk every canal and alley again.

name: Cenote Ik Kil
description: The cenotes were one of the great surprises of Yucatán, and Ik Kil made me wish we had time to explore many more.

name: Trinidad
description: My favorite place in Cuba, with colorful houses and a wonderful atmosphere. I would trade days in Havana to stay longer here.

name: Coco Bongo Cancún
description: Absurdly crowded and completely over the top, but the shows deliver and the night is worth experiencing.

name: Montmartre
description: The neighborhood and Sacré-Cœur are beautiful, and the panorama after climbing 290 steps is worth the effort.

name: Santorini Caldera Cliffs
description: Oia and the caldera views justified the crowds. The cliffside atmosphere made us glad we came.

name: Sarakiniko Beach
description: A natural wonder that feels like walking on the moon. It is worth visiting even when the wind makes swimming impossible.

name: Victoria Falls
description: Seeing the falls from both Zimbabwe and Zambia is one of those experiences that does not fit into a photograph.

name: Chobe National Park
description: An extraordinary safari where giraffes and elephants appeared before we even entered the park, in a landscape that feels genuinely open and wild.

name: Machu Picchu
description: A magnificent experience in a mystical mountain setting that left us promising to return for the Inca Trail and Huayna Picchu.

name: Amazon Rainforest
description: The open lodge, deafening animal sounds and the most peaceful sleep of my life made simply being inside the forest worth the journey.

name: Dospat
description: The fresh air and visual feast around Dospat Lake create the kind of experience that genuinely rejuvenates you.

name: Dubrovnik City Walls
description: The most enjoyable part of Dubrovnik, with magnificent views and a route we completed comfortably even with a small child.

name: Todai-ji
description: The most magnificent structure we saw in Japan, with a scale and grandeur that photographs cannot communicate.

name: Senso-ji
description: One of Tokyo's most beautiful temples, with a wonderful atmosphere that makes it an absolute must-see.

name: Nara Park
description: The deer interaction alone is worth the trip. It is playful, chaotic and completely different from anywhere else we visited in Japan.

name: Fushimi Inari
description: One of the most beautiful places we saw in Kyoto. The gates, forest and atmosphere justify the demanding full route.

name: Kapalı Maraş (Varosha)
description: A deeply affecting ghost city. Even the small portion currently open feels enormous and should stand as a lesson in what conflict leaves behind.

name: Hoi An Old Town
description: Larger and more detailed than it looks on a map. The alleys and edges of the historic core are as rewarding as the main streets.

name: Angkor Temple Complex
description: A vast landscape of temples where giant trees, stone ruins and tropical forest make Angkor Wat only the beginning of the experience.

name: Ba Na Hills Cable Car
description: The theme park is artificial, but the cable car above the clouds, Golden Bridge and giant Buddha made the trip worthwhile.

name: Buonconsiglio Castle Museum
description: The castle, museum rooms and mountain setting made this the cultural stop from Trento that stayed with us.

name: Ljubljana Old Town
description: Compact, walkable and full of atmosphere around the river, bridges and historic streets. It is enjoyable without a strict plan.

name: Flüela Pass
description: The high mountain road, sharp bends and alpine scenery turned the drive itself into one of the most memorable parts of the route.

name: Manuel Antonio Park Beach
description: The calm water and superb beach inside the park were unlike any other tropical coastline I had experienced.

name: Arenal Volcano
description: The four hour drive through cloud mountains was already magnificent, and the volcano waiting at the end made the route unforgettable.

name: Sagrada Família
description: The first building whose scale and grandeur left me genuinely speechless. Years later, Todai-ji was the only place that created the same feeling.

name: Faro Voltiano, Brunate
description: The climb above Lake Como leads to a lighthouse and a panorama that turns the entire lake into the experience.

name: Colosseum
description: One of the ancient landmarks that still overwhelms you in person, and the reference point I used when comparing every Roman arena afterward.

name: Grand Canyon
description: A magnificent natural wonder whose view remains unforgettable, even though I would choose the main South Rim over the heavily commercialized West Rim.

name: Fountains of Bellagio
description: The best thing we saw in Las Vegas, with meticulously choreographed shows that are worth watching from the center both during the day and at night.

name: Neydo Tashi Pharping Monastery
description: The beautiful setting and extraordinary Buddhist ceremony made this lesser known Pharping monastery one of the experiences that impressed us most in Nepal.

name: Initiation Well
description: A wonderful experience inside Quinta da Regaleira and one of the two places I would never skip on a visit to Sintra.

name: Pantheon
description: An ancient Roman landmark whose scale, preservation and extraordinary interior make it one of the places from Rome that stayed with me.
